alt: Ground crew workers with buckets and tools mopping water from the waterlogged Gillette Stadium pitch after a sprinkler flooded Iraq's penalty box during halftime of the Norway vs Iraq FIFA World Cup 2026 match
story: During halftime of Norway vs Iraq at Gillette Stadium (June 16, 2026), a sprinkler erupted in Iraq's penalty box and flooded the pitch; ground crew rushed in with buckets while Norway's coach simultaneously complained the grass was 'tinder dry.'
why_funny: The irrigation system at a FIFA World Cup venue managed to both drown one end of the pitch and leave the other parched — at the same time.
